name: HunyuanOCR-1.5
purpose: Lightweight end-to-end OCR VLM: document parsing, text spotting, information extraction and image-text translation up to 4K images.

license.name: Tencent Hunyuan Community License Agreement (custom)
license.notes: LICENSE text read. First line: "THIS LICENSE AGREEMENT DOES NOT APPLY IN THE EUROPEAN UNION, UNITED KINGDOM AND SOUTH KOREA"; Territory = worldwide excluding the EU, UK, South Korea, and using or distributing the works or their output outside the Territory is unlicensed (5c). Also: output must not be used to improve other AI models (5b), >100M MAU needs a separate license, an Acceptable Use Policy applies.

architecture.why_this_design: Speculative decoding via a block-diffusion drafter speeds OCR output (card).

engine_support.notes: llama.cpp PR 21395 (merged into HunyuanVL in release b9263); DFlash only in a community fork

benchmarks.name: MORE overall (149 languages)
benchmarks.variant: HunyuanOCR 1B (original); MORE de 98.10, best of the tested models

weaknesses: setup needs CUDA 13 for the unified path
soft.maturity: Tencent; second generation within the year

tona_fit.reason: best German score in MORE (98.10) and good in MDPBench, but the license does not apply in the EU, UK or South Korea: a German user has no license. Reject for Tona's users there regardless of quality; could only be offered to users outside the excluded territory.

sources.note: MDPBench README table read directly; an earlier summarizer pass mislabeled the Latin-average column as DE, the DE values here come from the dataset README
MORE benchmark read through a summarizer of the HTML version

pc-16gb.notes: BF16 about 2 GB; Tona runs one model at a time, so it replaces the resident model while it works
